svg.title: Two Bases and a Common Projector of C4
svg.desc: Two bases of H2: (1,0,-1,0)/√2 and (0,1,0,-1)/√2; (1,1,-1,-1)/2 and (-1,1,1,-1)/2. Their sums of rank-one matrices give the same rank-two projector E2.

cc:Work.dc:description: Two bases of H2: (1,0,-1,0)/√2 and (0,1,0,-1)/√2; (1,1,-1,-1)/2 and (-1,1,1,-1)/2. Their sums of rank-one matrices give the same rank-two projector E2.
